description: alpha-engine-config#6307 closes-when 3. `merged` is not terminal and `verified` is reachable (§3.8). m1 declares a post-merge verification obligation its own merged code produces: it merged, the predicate has not held, its deadline has not passed — so it is at `merged`, BLOCKED on the predicate, and NOT terminal. m2 declares the same predicate and the world reports it satisfied, so it has advanced to `verified` — the stage F7 measures lead time to. m3's obligation has passed its deadline unmet, so it is force-dispositioned to the named revert rather than resting for another interval (§3.6). m4 declares no obligation at all: the checks that permitted the merge were the verification, so it passes straight to `verified`.
